scope: Isolated RunGame and authoritative Run engine in Chrome mobile emulation, 390x844 DPR3, Apple Metal, CPU x4; not iPhone Safari or public-host acceptance
method: Time from authoritative startAt to the first enabled Jump button; fresh contexts, identical 1.5s countdown, three cold repetitions per HUD cadence
decision: The 250ms HUD cadence reduced React render work but was rejected because it added approximately 80-118ms to first-control unlock without fixing the 166.7ms WebGL long frame. Product cadence remains 100ms.
render_blocking_evidence: Chrome Long Animation Frame attributed the 166ms early active long task to the Run scene render2 RAF (approximately 164.8ms script), and the first-hit approximately 75ms long task to the same RAF (approximately 70.1ms script). The exact GPU/shader/texture sub-operation is not yet isolated.
